FloPlast boss adaptors are essential components designed to facilitate the reliable connection of 40mm waste pipes into a 110mm soil stack system. Constructed from durable black rubber, these adaptors create a secure, watertight seal for boss pipes and access branches. This robust design makes them ideal for professional plumbing installations, ensuring efficient wastewater management and preventing leaks. The adaptors' diameter offers compatibility for various drainage setups, making them a practical choice for plumbers and builders on diverse projects.
